name: radicle-sdk
description: TypeScript SDK for local signed Radicle project, issue and patch workflows

scripts.build:native: napi build --release --platform --manifest-path node/native/Cargo.toml --output-dir node/dist --js native.cjs --dts native.d.cts -- --locked
scripts.clean: node --input-type=module -e "import { rmSync } from 'node:fs'; rmSync('node/dist', { recursive: true, force: true });"
scripts.build: npm run clean && npm run build:native && tsc -p node/tsconfig.json
